name: video-storyboard
description: Scene-aware video storyboard plugin & MCP server built on SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard (v0.7.6, Apache-2.0): variable 1/1..1/8 DP row-packed grids, built-in offline sherpa-onnx ASR lifecycle, targeted OCR, video_clip, and video_cache_clean.
suggestedPrompts: Probe this video URL or local file first and summarize its duration and streams
Watch this video with video_storyboard, zoom any dense cell if needed, and clean the cache afterward
Find where a phrase is spoken with video_locate, or export an audio/video snippet with video_clip
